Name: UpdatedVoucherNumberByDate.XMLResponse
Content:
<action id="GetVoucherNumberByDate" ><text><![CDATA[
declare @voucherBook varchar(32)
select @voucherBook = @ma_nk
if @voucherBook <> '' begin
  if not exists(select 1 from v20dmnk where status = 1 and ma_nk = @voucherBook and so_ct0 <> so_ct2 and ((ma_dvcs = '') or (@ma_dvcs = '' and ma_dvcs = @@unit) or (ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs)) and (@ngay_ct between ngay_hl_tu and ngay_hl_den or ((ngay_hl_tu is null and @ngay_ct <= ngay_hl_den) or (ngay_hl_den is null and ngay_hl_tu <= @ngay_ct)) or (ngay_hl_tu is null and ngay_hl_den is null)) and ma_nk in (select ma_nk from v20dmctnk where ma_ct = @ma_ct and (lstuser = '' or charindex(',' + rtrim(@@userName) + ',', ',' + replace(lstuser, ' ', '') + ',') > 0))) begin
    select @voucherBook = ''
  end
end

if @voucherBook <> '' begin
  select '' as [return]
  return
end

if @voucherBook = ''
  select top 1 @voucherBook = ma_nk
    from v20dmnk where status = '1' and so_ct0 <> so_ct2 and
      ((ma_dvcs = '') or (@ma_dvcs = '' and ma_dvcs = @@unit) or (ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs)) and
      ((@ngay_ct >= ngay_hl_tu or ngay_hl_tu is null) and (@ngay_ct <= ngay_hl_den or ngay_hl_den is null)) and
      ma_nk in (select ma_nk from v20dmctnk where ma_ct = @ma_ct and (lstuser = '' or charindex(',' + rtrim(@@userName) + ',', ',' + replace(lstuser, ' ', '') + ',') > 0))

if exists(select 1 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @voucherBook) begin
  select @voucherBook as ma_nk, rtrim(ltrim(so_ct0)) as so_ct0 , rtrim(ltrim(so_ct1)) as so_ct1, rtrim(ltrim(so_ct2)) as so_ct2, rtrim(ltrim(isnull(so_seri, ''))) as ky_hieu from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @voucherBook
  return
end

declare @voucherNumber varchar(32)
select @voucherNumber = ltrim(rtrim(cast(so_ct as varchar(32)))) from dmct where ma_ct_me in (select ma_ct_me from dmct where ma_ct = @ma_ct)
select @voucherNumber as value
return
]]></text></action>
